description: This Java class defines a custom Servlet filter named OpenmrsFilter for the OpenMRS web application. It manages user context per request by ensuring the user's authentication info is set on the thread and session, and handles request pre-processing such as setting locale and security headers.

classes.name: OpenmrsFilter
classes.description: A custom web filter that ensures user context is correctly configured for each request, facilitates thread safety, and manages request-specific attributes.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Overrides the destroy method to perform cleanup when the filter is destroyed.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Main method invoked for each HTTP request; manages user context, session attributes, security headers, and thread context setup, then proceeds with the filter chain.
